test_title: PYST 12 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
What comes next in the series?

PQ / P Q R / P Q R S / P Q R S T / P Q R S T U / P Q R S T U V / ______

options.text: P Q R S T U V W
P Q R S T U V W X
Q R S T U V W
P Q R S T U W X

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/616bbc0450198884d8c61486e3afb3f69092bbffd3dbe24cbf38453d22248d57.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given series:

PQ / P Q R / P Q R S / P Q R S T / P Q R S T U / P Q R S T U V

Logic: Each term adds one more consecutive letter in alphabetical order starting from P.

So, next term will include one more letter after V → W

Thus, next term = P Q R S T U V W

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
